probe.primary_estimator: sklearn.linear_model.LogisticRegression(penalty='l2', fit_intercept=True), C selected on dev only
probe.secondary_estimator: difference-of-means direction (no upstream equivalent; our robustness check)
probe.no_cuml: upstream uses cuML/RAPIDS; we use sklearn (no GPU needed at probe-fit scale, avoids RAPIDS dependency)
probe.class_space_frozen: fixed per experiment and never mixed across experiments (upstream predict_proba is class-space-relative; see Appendix A9.7)
probe.secondary: token-by-token Bombness map across the full prompt (descriptive)
probe.layers: every layer 0..32 (Llama-8B; cost trivial), headline layer selected on dev, frozen before holdout

extraction.primitive: pair_common.capture_components(lm, templated_text, probe_word, components, positions) — one forward pass -> {resid_pre, attn_out, mlp_out, resid_post} x {codeword_last, following, final_prompt, first_generated}. resid_post == D1 space.
extraction.position_source: v3 corpus field codeword_occurrences_templated (precomputed exact token positions) — NO substring heuristic needed
extraction.padding: explicit position_ids from the attention mask, or per-example forward passes / right-padding. Do NOT inherit upstream left-pad + arange(0,N) position_ids (Appendix A9.2 / D5).
extraction.add_special_tokens: false on already-templated text (single BOS); positions double as patch positions (18_run_behavioral_necessity.capture_reps_for_gen convention)

intervention.primitive: ds_common.LayerPatch(model, layer_idx, positions, vector, mode, alpha)
intervention.orthogonalization: v_bomb_perp_refusal, v_refusal_perp_bomb via explicit Gram-Schmidt; report cosine before/after
intervention.dose_calibration: natural state units — fraction of Direct<->Neutral concept-state gap, grid {0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0} x gap (plan 8.2); large off-manifold dose is a separate stress arm, cannot establish specificity
